messages:
support-jordan: FYI customer BrightPay reporting intermittent 504s + very high p95 on hosted API since ~09:30UTC. Calls hitting /v1/generate. They provided corrs: abc123, def456. Said errors look like timeouts (504) rather than model errors.
liam-sre: Looking at metrics — request_queue_length for tenant=brightpay spiked from ~40 -> 420 around 09:28. p95 jumped 2.4s -> 12.1s. Gateway started returning 504 when dequeue timed out. Can someone collect gateway+batcher logs and CB backlog?
maria-g: grabbing logs now. Early read: continuous-batcher backlog rising and kvcache evictions spike at same time. Looks like deferred enqueue storm where many long-seq requests pile up and block short ones. Snippet: 
```
# prometheus sample
request_queue_length{tenant="brightpay"} 420
continuous_batch_backlog{pool="cbatch-1"} 380
kvcache_evictions_total 1200
queue_dequeue_time_seconds_bucket{le="0.1"} 300
queue_dequeue_time_seconds_bucket{le="5"} 1500
```
eng-runtime-kate: Agree with Maria. Tenant saw a flood of long-seq jobs that forced large batches and caused KV miss thrash. Quick mitigations: 1) enforce smaller max_batch_size for tenant; 2) tighten max_queue_depth for hosted route; 3) enable immediate_fallback to a smaller model variant for >X tokens. Example command (temporary):
```
redwoodctl set-tenant-config brightpay --max-queue-depth=200 --max-batch-size=8 --enable-immediate-fallback=true
```
liam-sre: Can we try that on a canary for 1 pool and run a controlled repro? Also get a trace for one failing request (corr abc123).
maria-g: pulled gateway logs for abc123: shows enqueue accepted then dequeued after ~11.2s and gateway returned 504 before model finished. Stack: gateway -> router -> cbatcher -> pool. KV eviction count spikes match CB backlog windows.
oncall-taylor: Per runbook step 3: if continuous-batcher backlog >300 and p95>5s, apply tenant soft-throttle + reduce batch size. I'll apply the tenant config change as a canary to pool cbatch-1 and watch.
deploy-bot: canary-config-apply: success — brightpay config updated on cbatch-1 (uid: cfg-2026-04-02-09-45). Rolling to 10% of pool nodes.
liam-sre: Running loadgen repro to validate (local cmd):
```
wrk -t2 -c50 -d60s https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY' -s tools/longseq.lua
```
support-jordan: I've informed BrightPay we are throttling long-seq jobs as a temporary mitigation and will continue monitoring. They asked for ETA on full fix.
maria-g: After canary applied p95 dropped from 12.1s -> 1.1s for short requests within 6 minutes. Continuous_batch_backlog down to ~30. KV evictions cadence normalized.
oncall-taylor: Keeping incident open until 24h of stable metrics. Next action items: eng-runtime to propose permanent controls (per-tenant batch caps, long-seq queue separation), SRE to add an alert on rapid queue-depth growth + kvcache-eviction spike.
eng-runtime-kate: Will draft design: dedicated long-seq queue + dynamic fallback policy + adaptive batch cutover. ETA EOD tomorrow for proposal.
liam-sre: Added alert: ALERT RequestQueueSpike: when request_queue_length delta >150 within 2m AND kvcache_evictions_rate >100/min.
support-jordan: Customer updated — appreciated quick mitigation, will await long-term fix. I'll keep them in the loop. :thumbsup:
liam-sre: Closing workitem for now but keeping thread open for postmortem notes. If we need immediate rollback of config run `redwoodctl rollback-config brightpay --uid=cfg-2026-04-02-09-45`.
